test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct phrase for the word highlighted in bold.

The restaurant was so noisy, **I could hardly hear myself think.**

options.text: The food in the restaurant was not tasty.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"hardly hear myself think"** refers to a situation where the environment is extremely loud, making it difficult to concentrate or process thoughts. (बहुत शोरगुल भरा) • **Example:** The concert was so noisy that I could hardly hear myself think. • **"Noisy"** means full of loud or unpleasant sounds, often causing disturbance or distraction. (शोरगुल वाला) • **Example:** The noisy classroom made it hard for the teacher to focus on the lesson. • Hence, the statement implies the restaurant was very loud. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2:** The food in the restaurant was not tasty. (रेस्टोरेंट का खाना स्वादिष्ट नहीं था) • **Example:** The food at the roadside stall was not tasty, so I decided not to eat there. • **Option 3:** The restaurant had bright lighting. (रेस्टोरेंट में तेज रोशनी थी) • **Example:** The restaurant's bright lighting created a cheerful atmosphere. • **Option 4:** The restaurant had poor service. (रेस्टोरेंट की सेवा खराब थी) • **Example:** We decided not to return to the restaurant because of its poor service. 34:T9db, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Ergophile**.
